models.notes: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 Standard tier via the OpenAI-compatible Meta Model API Responses endpoint. Reasoning model at model-default high effort; uses model-default reasoning settings. 16384 output cap: the 4096-cap probe returned status incomplete with all 4096 tokens spent on reasoning, and live outputs reach ~6900 tokens, so 16384 keeps headroom above observed reasoning volume. Same $1.25/$4.25 standard pricing as 1.2; prompts never train Meta models.
models.pricing_notes: Standard tier rates in USD per million tokens; cached input $0.15/M not assumed. Output includes reasoning tokens.
